purpose: First bounded local-model integration smoke test of merged main; no attribution-method superiority or task-generalization claim.
sampling_note: Temperature zero and paired requested seeds are integration controls; two seeds are not independent stochastic or held-out task observations.
payments: Isolated synthetic payment worlds only. No real payment service is connected.
failure_handling: Retain provider/protocol failure receipts and unknown outcomes. Refuse incomplete target estimates. Do not redraw a failed branch within a run.
